summary: sanitizeHandle (sweep-1 player-1 fix) strips only unicode.IsControl (category Cc). It does NOT strip Unicode format/bidi/zero-width characters (U+202E RTL-OVERRIDE, U+200B ZERO-WIDTH SPACE, U+FEFF BOM, U+200E/200F LRM/RLM, combining marks). A hostile mobile handle can therefore still reverse/scramble the scoreboard, lockout banner and telemetry render on stage/admin, or store a visually-empty handle. The 'strip control chars' remediation is incomplete for the injection vector it was meant to close.
scenario: Mobile sends Hello handle "\u202Egnp" (RTL override + text). unicode.IsControl(U+202E)==false, so it survives. Broadcast in SMsgScoreboard/SMsgLockout to stage+admin, where the browser flips subsequent glyph order, corrupting every downstream name on the projector. Verified in Go: unicode.IsControl reports false for U+202E, U+200B, U+FEFF, U+200F, U+0301.
suggested_fix: Also drop unicode.Is(unicode.C, r) (covers Cf format chars) or an explicit reject set {Cc, Cf, and the bidi overrides U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069}; strip leading/trailing combining marks; and treat an all-format/zero-width result as empty (return "") so the caller keeps the prior handle.

summary: checkDailyDoubleComplete (sweep-1 engine-3 fix) tests completion with a bare length compare `len(e.ratings) >= len(e.ratingPool)`, but a rater who is kicked/disconnected AFTER rating is removed from ratingPool (onAdminKick/OnDisconnect delete from ratingPool) while their entry STAYS in e.ratings. The two sets then diverge: |ratings| can reach |ratingPool| while a still-eligible pool member has not voted. The daily double finishes prematurely, silently dropping the remaining eligible rater's vote, and finishDailyDouble averages in the departed player's stars — skewing the bonus.
scenario: Pool {A,B,C}. A rates 5, B rates 4 (ratings={A:5,B:4}). Admin kicks A: onAdminKick deletes A from ratingPool -> ratingPool={B,C}, ratings unchanged. onAdminKick then calls checkDailyDoubleComplete: len(ratings)=2 >= len(ratingPool)=2 -> finishDailyDouble fires though C (eligible, online) never rated; C's input is lost and A's kicked 5-star rating still counts toward the average/bonus.
suggested_fix: On kick/disconnect also delete the player from e.ratings, OR count only ratings whose key is still in ratingPool: `n:=0; for id:=range e.ratings { if e.ratingPool[id] { n++ } }; if n>=len(e.ratingPool)` and average over that same intersection in finishDailyDouble.
